_README: Single source of truth for the ten job clusters, shared by the backend API
(GET /api/clusters) and the assignment script. The 'cluster' values MUST match
the cluster names stored in the main study's all_emails collection, because the
allowlists produced from this survey are used to launch the main study per
cluster: Finance, IT Support, HR, Sales, Operations, Customer Service,
'titles' are the qualifying job titles as worded in the Prolific screener
(prolific_study_creation/screening.txt). They are shown under each job area on
the survey so a participant selects against concrete job titles rather than an
abstract area label, which is what went wrong in the first pilot.
'role' and 'roleDescription' are the assigned role the main study would ask
them to imagine. They are copied from the main app's content.json 'roles' block
and must stay in step with it.
'target' is how many completed participants the main study needs for that
cluster. Used only by scripts/assign_clusters.py, never by the survey itself.

clusters.roleDescription: Runs day-to-day business operations, working with operations and facilities colleagues.
Handles KYC/CDD checks, transaction-monitoring alerts and case escalations.
Supports senior leadership with scheduling, travel, correspondence and office coordination.
Handles corporate customer accounts, orders and complaints.
Handles company accounts, ledgers, reconciliations and financial reporting.
Manages business customer accounts, quotes, deals and follow-ups.
Owns marketing campaigns and budgets, working with sales, finance and marketing colleagues.

titles: IT Support Technician or Helpdesk Support
clusters.roleDescription: Front-line IT helpdesk, handling requests from managers, IT colleagues and internal staff.
Coordinates hiring end to end, working with managers and HR and payroll colleagues.
Handles company purchasing, supplier quotes, orders and contracts.
